1. 히브리인의 찬송가\n 1) 시편은 일반적으로 시라기 보다는 히브인의:
1. The Hebrews' hymnbook
 1) Psalms is generally not so much poetry as the Hebrews' hymnbook. It's a hymnal that collected the praises the Israelites sang in the time of Zerubbabel's temple.
곡조가 있는게 있고 그냥 가사문학식으로 되어 있는 것도 있었는데 오늘 날:
Some had tunes, and some were just written as lyric poetry, but today we can't know the tunes.
 2) The Psalms weren't all written at once, and they weren't all collected at once either. The writing took about a thousand years, from Moses down to the sons of Asaph.
5차례에 걸쳐서 편집하는데 1~41, 42~72, 73~89, 90~10:
It was edited in five stages, and it's divided into Psalms 1~41, 42~72, 73~89, 90~106, and 107~150. Of all the books in our Bible, this is the one that took the longest.
 3) If you look at the authors, nearly half, about 73 psalms, are David's.
군인이고 정치가인데 이런 음악적인 재능: A soldier and a politician, and yet such musical talent
그가 이렇게 많은 시편을 남길 수 있었던 것은 기도를 생각하고 정리해서: The reason he could leave so many psalms is that he thought through his prayers, organized them, and always wrote them down.
이외에도 아삽자손이 한 12편, 고라자손이 10편, 솔로몬이 2편, 모세:
Besides that, about 12 are by the sons of Asaph, 10 by the sons of Korah, 2 by Solomon, then Moses, Heman, Ethan, Ezra, and some by unknown authors.
 4) Psalm 119 in particular is thought to have been written by Ezra, and he wrote it in the order of the Hebrew alphabet.
두문시 형식. 그런데 거의 모든 구절에 주의 법, 증거, 도, 법도, 율: It's an acrostic poem. And almost every verse has a word like your law, testimonies, ways, precepts, statutes, commandments, judgments, word, ordinances, precepts, your truth.
2. Kinds of Psalms
 1) Mizmor: pure psalm
 2) Shir: song. The Song of Songs is called Shir HaShirim.
 3) Maskil: meditative psalm
 4) Miktam: satirical psalm
 5) Tefillah: prayer psalm
 6) Tehillah: praise psalm
 - Besides those there are psalms of confession of faith, wisdom psalms, historical psalms, teaching psalms, and even curse psalms.
역사를 잘 알면 더욱 이해가 쉬운 부분이 있다.\n - 시편 34편 ::
Some parts are much easier to understand if you know the history well.
 - Psalm 34: written after David pretended to be insane before Abimelech and was driven out
 - Psalm 51: when the prophet Nathan came to David after he had slept with Bathsheba
 - Psalm 126: when they came back from Exile
 - Psalm 137: when they were mocked during the Babylonian Exile
